mapper.select: select cate_id from brand b join post_brand pb on pb.brand_id = b.brand_id where post_no = #{post_no} group by cate_id
select record_no from like_record where post_no = #{post_no} and date = current_date()
mapper.insert: insert into bookmark(bookmark_date, post_no, member_uuid) values (current_timestamp(), #{post_no}, #{member_uuid})
insert into star (star, post_no, member_uuid) values (#{star}, #{post_no}, #{member_uuid})
mapper.select: select * from image where post_no=#{post_no} order by ord
mapper.insert: insert into reply(content, post_no, member_uuid) values (#{reply_content}, #{post_no}, #{member_uuid})
mapper.select: select reply_no, content as reply_content, reg_Date as reply_reg_date, mod_date as reply_mod_date, reply_like, post_no, member_uuid from reply where post_no = #{post_no} order by reply_like
select type_id as tag_id, type_name as tag_name from report_type
mapper.insert: insert into report(report_type, content, post_no, member_uuid) values (#{report_type}, #{content}, #{post_no}, #{member_uuid})
